mode: READ-ONLY shovel-ready prep (g-cond). NO capture / NO deposit / NO cluster-S3 write. The recalage capability is BLOCKED (owner-level). This file is a tiered, source-assessed worklist to be executed by a FUTURE capability spike once unblocked.
purpose: Enumerate the in-cohort (B-prime 167) zones-v2 gaps that are PDF-recalage-bound (no live vector source-identity endpoint), tier them by the ACTUAL plan source found, and rank shovel-readiness so a geo-archi + recalage-codex spike on T1/T2 can start immediately.
anti_invention: Tiers are assigned from the REAL source found (WebFetch/WebSearch of the municipal plan) where verified, else labelled tier_confidence=estimated (default T3 = published municipal plan PDF, internals not fetched). A candidate with no public georeferenceable plan is documented 'no-public-plan', never given a fabricated tier. estimated_yield is a LABELLED estimate (analog served-muni zone counts by size band), not a measured claim.

tier_legend.T1: GeoPDF auto-calage — PDF carries embedded georeferencing (OGC GeoPDF / Adobe geo / QGIS geospatial-PDF with CRS+neatline). Auto-calage feasible; highest yield / lowest effort.
tier_legend.T2: vecto-calque — vector-layer PDF (selectable vector zone polygons/labels, e.g. QGIS/CAD layout export without embedded georef). Vectorize the layer + affine-fit on 2-3 control points.
tier_legend.T3: raster georef — raster/flattened image PDF or PNG plan, no georef. Needs georeferencing via control points.
tier_legend.T4: scan cale-sur-lots — scanned/low-quality plan. Needs anchoring on cadastral lots.
tier_legend.no-public-plan: no public georeferenceable zoning PLAN found (by-law TEXT may exist, or plan is behind email/proprietary viewer). Genuinely stuck for recalage.
tier_legend.other-gap: NOT a PDF-tier problem — a different capability gap (proprietary-viewer / web-map-embedded / token / zip-shapefile / request-bounded).

summary.note_count: g-cond estimated ~41; by-construction the in-cohort PDF-recalage gap is 51 (48 PDF-tier T1-T4 + 2 no-public-plan + 1 other-gap). The 7 already-served (franklin, ormstown, saint-mathieu-de-beloeil, sainte-catherine, sainte-clotilde, varennes, vercheres) were RIEN in the 2026-08-10 vector re-scan but already carry a live v2 proof per the 2026-08-02 overlap, so they are NOT gaps and are excluded.
summary.verified_note: Verified by WebFetch of the actual plan PDF: saint-amable (T1 GeoPDF), vaudreuil-dorion (T2 QGIS vector), chateauguay (T3 raster), beloeil (T3 raster), sainte-julienne (T3 image-heavy). rosemere (no-public-plan) verified by search. All other T3 rows are tier_confidence=estimated: a published municipal plan PDF is assumed (per discovery note 'reglement PDF') and defaulted to T3; the spike must confirm each PDF's internals (a QGIS/CAD export may upgrade to T2/T1, an old scan may downgrade to T4).

spike_ready_note: START with the T1/T2 shovel-ready wins: (1) saint-amable — VERIFIED GeoPDF (recto/verso plans, WGS84 Web Mercator CRS + OCG layers embedded) => T1 auto-calage, immediate. (2) vaudreuil-dorion — VERIFIED QGIS-exported vector plan (Annexe 1, 5 feuillets, QGIS 3.44 producer) => T2 vectorize; likely T1 if the QGIS 'georeference' export flag was on (verify the Geo/LGIDict). These 2 are the highest-value / lowest-effort in-cohort candidates and let the spike prove the T1 GeoPDF auto-calage path AND the T2 vecto-calque path on real data before scaling to the T3 raster bulk. NEXT, re-fetch the recent (2022-2026) 'codifie' / multi-sheet plans (les-coteaux R19 2022, saint-stanislas-de-kostka 330-2018 A/B/C, chateauguay Annexe-A 2025, vaudreuil-dorion feuillets 1-4) to reclassify T3->T2/T1 where they too are GIS-vector exports — the QGIS/GeoPDF production pattern is spreading, so the real T1/T2 count is probably higher than the 2 verified today. The T3 raster bulk (Montreal-ring cities: beloeil, chateauguay, pointe-claire, dorval, sainte-therese, ...) is standard control-point georeferencing, highest absolute yield but higher per-muni effort.
